conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced was found: the Q3 numbers are new (no profit warning, no pre-release), so the move is sized large at 13% on a 142% realised-vol name whose last two prints moved -11.7% and -24.4%. p_up sits at 48 because the small positive finding sum (+0.8, mostly the crowded quant short and the already-announced Q4 LiDAR shipments) is outweighed by a reaction function that has sold both prints since the Q4-inflection narrative began. So the two numbers disagree in sign by design.

findings.finding: Q3 social-security liability reversal: the share fell from SEK 63.15 (30 Jun) to SEK 31.48 (30 Sep), and by the mechanism the company itself disclosed for Q2 (+42.9m expense on a 10.71->63.15 rise) Q3 should carry a non-cash credit of roughly SEK 20-30m, about +0.06-0.08 of EPS against a -0.10 bar, with no pre-announcement this time.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 expense was pre-announced 13 Aug (stock -4.8% that day, amid wider moves); no history of a reversal print.
findings.why_not_priced: A two-analyst name with a single Yahoo EPS estimate; if the estimate already held the credit the bar would sit near -0.05, not -0.10. But it is non-cash, the company itself calls it non-operational, and a beat made of a one-off is sold, so it is small.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue faces a SEK 72.5m Q3 2025 comparison after Q2 printed 53.8m with NRE deliberately deprioritised, so a headline YoY decline of roughly 20-30% is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 revenue -12% YoY with the NRE trade-off explained: stock -24.4% the next session (2026-08-28); Q1 report: -11.7% (2026-06-01).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the company told the market Q4, not Q3, is the inflection, and the stock has fallen 41% in 20 sessions. What remains is the headline print on a name whose last two reports were sold. If the decline were fully in, the last two NRE-trade-off prints would not have moved -12% and -24%.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 report states the NRE deprioritisation: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aa95ee9f88658eb619ebf069c85abbfdc

findings.finding: US FY2027 began on a continuing resolution running to 11 Dec 2026 under which over 150 new military programmes cannot start, so the US defence NRE that Sivers already said slipped on budget approvals may slip again and weigh on the Q4-inflection statement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 cited US defence budget delays as a reason for the revenue drop; stock -24.4% next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission. The company has not said the CR hits Q4, and defence is a minority of revenue next to LiDAR, SATCOM and FWA, so it is a hypothesis and sized small.
findings.independence: Company's own statement that H1 revenue slipped on US government budget approvals: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b9452a3cf30620fe8ff03c0d406e56315&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: The strategic LiDAR customer placed production orders with shipments starting Q4 2026 (lifetime potential USD 53-138m), alongside the USD 8.2m ALL.SPACE and USD 3m Tachyon production orders. These are the concrete items the report can point to when it reaffirms the Q4 revenue inflection.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q4-inflection narrative accompanied the Q2 print, which fell 24.4%; the LiDAR order release on 2026-10-20 moved the stock -0.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: The orders are public. What is not public is whether the report puts a number on Q4 shipments or order intake, which would turn a narrative the market has stopped paying for into a figure. The -41% 20-day run-up says the market is discounting the inflection, not holding it.
findings.independence: Q2 CEO letter: 'We are expecting orders from our strategic LiDAR customer for Q4 2026' https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aa95ee9f88658eb619ebf069c85abbfdc

findings.finding: Disclosed net short is 7.41% and building (+0.12pp to 2026-11-26), held mostly by quant/momentum funds (GSA 0.81%, Arrowstreet 0.61%, Two Sigma, AQR, D E Shaw, Citadel), into a stock down 41% in 20 sessions and about 80% from its June peak.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-11-23 +18.6% and 2026-11-26 +9.8% squeezes inside a downtrend show how violently it reverses; the shorts were not squeezed by either of the last two prints.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is already the largest term in the baseline's priced_lean (+3.0 squeeze). Kept small because momentum quants cover mechanically on a reversal, which a fundamental short would not, so any reaffirmed Q4 number gets amplified.

findings.finding: Sivers is debt-free after the July SEK 700m raise and the August USD 5m repayment. That leaves an estimated ~SEK 0.5-0.6bn at end Q3 against a ~SEK 70m quarterly operating burn plus the USD 30m Glasgow build, so no raise is needed inside the window, and the money is buying ramp capacity rather than plugging a hole.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A financing overhang drove Redeye's earlier 'short-term financing a question mark' note; the April and July raises came at a falling price.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since August. A residual risk is that the US dual listing in H1 2027 is read as a future raise, so it is near zero.

baseline_tension: Findings net slightly positive and agree with the priced lean (+4.8, mostly the short-squeeze term). The steep negative run-up cuts both ways, and the reaction function (two prints sold by 12% and 24%) pulls p_up just below 50, so the scaled number is a small negative against a +0.8 finding sum.
language_note: Every Sivers filing goes out simultaneously in English and Swedish with identical content (checked on the 20 Nov date-change release: 'Rapporten offentliggörs cirka kl. 18.00 CET'). The filing adds nothing locally.

The Swedish press (EFN, Placera telegrams) carried only short-register entries and June volatility stories. The named quant short holders were the one local datum, and German-language aggregators carried them as well. Nothing the English sources did not already carry on the Q3 numbers.

'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': US CR finding cut from -0.7 to -0.4
'Size the move on what is new, let reaction history move p_up': abs_move kept at 13 and p_up at 48, both unchanged
